scientific_integrity: Analytic proof based on reproducing-kernel identity, Schwarz–Pick and uniform angular asymptotics; finite tests are supplementary only.
scientific_limitations: Theorem covers 0<s<1 and bounded unweighted composition operators with origin-fixing symbols. No classification of arbitrary weighted or non-origin-fixing symbols, no independent validation, and publication priority remains subject to further scrutiny.
title: Exact cusp openings and origin-fixed Berezin convexity on weighted Dirichlet spaces
